% 9-online_appendix.tex -- the online appendix: numbering and paths set here, the text generated elsewhere
% ======================================================================================================================
% The body is online_appendix/31-OnlineAppendix.tex, GENERATED from 1_code/31-OnlineAppendix.qmd in the pipeline
% repository. Do not edit that file here: an edit is lost at the next render. Comment on it, and the change goes
% into the .qmd.
%
% TWO THINGS THE PAPER'S PREAMBLE NEEDS. \usepackage{adjustbox}, which every table 30 writes uses to shrink a wide
% table (booktabs is loaded already). And \input{online_appendix/OA-Numbers}, which defines \oanum{Key} for every
% number the appendix cites, so the main text can cite the same numbers.
{
\makeatletter
\setcounter{figure}{0}
\setcounter{table}{0}
\renewcommand{\section}{\@startsection{section}{1}{\z@}%
  {-3.5ex \@plus -1ex \@minus -.2ex}%
  {2.3ex \@plus.2ex}%
  {\centering\Huge\bfseries}}
\makeatother

\section*{Online Appendix}
}
\captionsetup[figure]{list=no}
\captionsetup[table]{list=no}

\doublespacing
\setcounter{subsection}{0}

\renewcommand\thesubsection{\Alph{subsection}}
\renewcommand\thesubsubsection{\thesubsection.\arabic{subsubsection}}

\renewcommand\thetable{\thesubsection\arabic{table}}
\renewcommand\thefigure{\thesubsection\arabic{figure}}

% Tables and figures restart at 1 in every lettered section -- A1, A2, B1 -- with no \setcounter in the text.
\counterwithin*{table}{subsection}
\counterwithin*{figure}{subsection}

% WHERE THE FILES SIT IN THIS PROJECT. \oaexhibits is the folder holding 30's deployed Tables/, Notes/ and Figures/
% (the contents of 200-Paper_figures/current/); \oastatic the folder holding the paper's own static tables.
\newcommand{\oaexhibits}{exhibits/}
\newcommand{\oastatic}{tables/}

\clearpage
\input{online_appendix/31-OnlineAppendix}
